headline: Life is better when we explore it together.
lead: We are Steve and Dianne Simonton, and some of our favorite memories have been made while discovering new places together.
introductionParagraphs: We love traveling, learning the history behind the places we visit, taking photographs, sharing great meals, and turning those experiences into stories that our family can keep.
Every trip gives us another opportunity to laugh, explore, learn something new, and create memories together.
highlight: Steve would also like the official record to reflect that his wife is incredibly hot, and traveling the world with her is his favorite adventure.
storyParagraphs: What started as a simple idea to preserve our own memories slowly became something much bigger. As we planned our trips, captured photographs, organized reservations, wrote stories, and designed our books, we kept asking ourselves why there wasn't one place that brought everything together.

That question eventually inspired a much bigger vision—to build a platform that could help anyone preserve meaningful adventures, not just ours. That vision became AdventuresSuite, the platform powering The Simonton Adventures and, someday, many other creators who want to transform their journeys into lasting legacies.

The Simonton Adventures is our story. AdventuresSuite is the platform that grew from it. Together they represent our belief that every meaningful adventure deserves to be remembered, shared, and passed on to future generations.
